history.text: Retired when it was unified with the NWA National Heavyweight Championship.
Revived by NWA Georgia, with Billy Black awarded the title.
NWA Georgia became NWA Wildside after merging with National Championship Wrestling, and the title was renamed.
Retired when NWA Wildside ceased operations.
NWA Action revived the title, restoring the NWA Georgia name; Cru Jones won it over Steve Stiles.
Tommy Too Much, the NWA Atlanta champion, beat Odinson in a unification match.
Per the article, the title was either unified in 2015 or retired in February 2016; the source is unclear.
NWA Georgia recognized Mike Pain as champion after NWA Atlanta closed operations.
NWA ended its promotional licenses worldwide, and the title was declared vacant.
The title was revived under the new Georgia Championship Wrestling, and Terry Lawler won it in a 20-man Rumble.
Georgia Championship Wrestling was rebranded as Georgia Classic Wrestling, and the titles remained active.
